theme_and_archetype.vibe: Intimate, warm, growth-oriented, premium, calm, cinematic
theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an app managing relationships, intimacy, and mental well-being (via Bently AI), the UI must feel safe, organic, and premium. A blend of warm earthy tones with elegant typography evokes an 'Old Money Tech' or 'Editorial Wellness' aesthetic.

rules.tints: Never use pure black or pure white. All grays are tinted with olive/warm sand.
rules.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA. Over imagery, use subtle gradient underlays or text-shadow.
rules.gradients: Avoid flat gradients. Use noise/grain textures or subtle radial glows to highlight areas.

rules.pairing: High contrast pairing: Emotional, high-style Serif for headings (Cormorant Garamond), balanced by extremely sterile and legible Sans-Serif for dashboard data and chat (Manrope).
rules.weights: Avoid generic 'bold' everywhere. Use font-light for elegance in big text, or font-semibold for clarity.
rules.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content. Center-align hero headings only if symmetric.

grid_system.mobile: Strict single column, prioritizing vertical rhythm and sticky bottom action bars for native feel.

rules.breathing_room: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical SaaS. Value negative space.
rules.mobile_images: max-h-[70vh] on mobile to prevent full screen takeover.
rules.padding_collision: All containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to protect text.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2C3B2E] text-[#F9F6F0] rounded-full hover:bg-[#1A221B] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2C3B2E] text-[#2C3B2E] rounded-full hover:bg-[#2C3B2E]/5

surfaces.cards: bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E6E2DA] rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surfaces.chat_bubbles: Partner: bg-[#FDFBF7] border border-[#E6E2DA]. User: bg-[#2C3B2E] text-white. AI Bently: bg-[#E6D5B8]/30 border border-[#C25934]/20.

shadcn_overrides.inputs: Remove default focus ring, use custom focus:border-[#8BA88E] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8BA88E]
shadcn_overrides.dialog: Use rounded-3xl, remove generic dark overlays, use backdrop-blur-md bg-black/20

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Subtle -translate-y-1 on cards. Explicit hover text color changes.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer motion opacity and y-axis drift (y: 10 to 0) on mount.
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Heart icons pulse on click. Bently AI typing indicator should feel organic (staggered opacity dots).

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Thin weights to match the premium editorial feel.

hero_auth.description: Abstract organic sage/terracotta backdrop for Auth/Onboarding.

hero_marketing.description: Cinematic couple holding hands for landing page hero.

dashboard_texture.description: Warm abstract texture for journal or mission background cards.

partnership_placeholder.description: Partner profile placeholder or relationship milestone banner.

test_id_rules.scope: All interactive elements, forms, critical links, and state-bearing text must have a data-testid.

implementation_instructions_to_main_agen: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react (if shadcn uses it default, but prefer phosphor for app icons), clsx, tailwind-merge.

Setup routing for Mobile (PWA) vs Desktop. The mobile view must feature a sticky bottom navigation bar (Home, Partner, Bently AI, Journal, Settings). Desktop should use a sidebar or top elegant navigation.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Implement Shadcn, but drastically alter the default aesthetics. Remove heavy borders, increase border radius to 2xl/3xl, use the custom organic color palette, and avoid flat vercel-like greys.
For the Bently AI Chat interface, make it distinct from standard messaging. Use the 'accent' background for Bently's bubbles and a premium glassmorphic input bar.
Build the dashboard using a 'Bento' style for relationship metrics (Journal streaks, upcoming missions).
Preserve backend logic if connecting to bmdadaee/axmcommonground. Adapt UI purely to consume the state without breaking it.
Strictly follow the test_id_rules for every interactive element.
